segments.title: Soya's icebreaker hull and later modifications
segments.summary: An exterior view of Soya identifies her as an icebreaker and points out the permanent hull bulges left by later modifications.
segments.body: Soya is an icebreaker with conspicuous modifications to her hull. The large bulges visible along her sides are permanent features. Their exact technical purpose is not explained during this brief exterior look at the ship. A fuller visit is planned for the following day.

evidence.note: The transcript identifies Soya as an icebreaker and calls out her permanent hull bulges as interesting modifications.
